firebird_root_dir.description: Root directory where Firebird binaries, libraries, and default data are installed.

tcpip_port.description: TCP port for remote connections. Set to 0 to disable TCP/IP.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed. Must not exceed your license limit.

cached_pages.description: Page cache size (in 8 KB pages). Increase for better performance on large databases.

security_database.description: Path to the Firebird security database (gsec user database).

remote_access.description: Allow remote clients to connect over TCP/IP. Set false for local-only use.

default_database_path.description: Default directory used when CREATE DATABASE is given a relative path.

connection_timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout (not recommended).

thread_pool_size.description: Number of worker threads for background tasks like shadow creation.

lock_file_prefix.description: Path prefix for lock files used by the lock manager.

log_path.description: Directory for server log files. Leave blank to disable logging.

log_max_size.description: Maximum log file size in MB before rotation. 0 = no rotation.

auth_server.description: Authentication methods the server offers to clients, ordered by preference.

items.description: Authentication plugin name (e.g., 'Srp' for secure password protocol, 'Legacy_Auth' for compatibility).

auth_client.description: Authentication methods the server will accept from clients.

allow_user_creation.description: Allow database users to be created via SQL (e.g., CREATE USER).

allow_shadow_creation.description: Enable automatic creation of shadow files for database durability.

gc_max_threads.description: Maximum garbage collection threads per database (for high-concurrency workloads).

temp_directory.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., sort spills, blob staging).

auto_cleanup.description: Enable automatic cleanup of unused database segments.

lock_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a lock before raising an error.

use_shared_memory.description: Enable shared memory for local connections (faster; disable for NFS-only setups).

read_ahead_pages.description: Number of pages to read ahead per I/O for sequential scans.

reverse_dns_lookup.description: Enable DNS reverse lookups to log hostnames instead of IPs in connection logs.

listen_addresses.description: IP addresses to bind to (empty = all). Use IPv6 in brackets if needed.

default_isolation.description: Default transaction isolation: 'SNAPSHOT' (recommended), 'SNAPSHOT NO WAIT', or 'READ COMMITTED'.

default_transaction_access_mode.description: Default transaction access: 'READ WRITE' or 'READ ONLY'.

aliases_file.description: Path to the aliases configuration file.

allow_config_overrides.description: Allow environment variable FIREBIRD_CONF to override firebird.conf path.

database_trace.description: Enable database-level tracing (requires Firebird 4.0+ and plugin).

io_worker_threads.description: Number of I/O worker threads (Linux uses POSIX AIO; usually 1 is sufficient).

worker_timeout.description: Idle worker thread timeout in seconds.

remote_gstat_enabled.description: Enable remote gstat queries (for monitoring tools).

remote_sql_enabled.description: Enable remote service queries via isql and similar tools.

message_length.description: Maximum message buffer size in bytes (for event notification).

plugins.description: List of plugins to load. Each has name, library, enabled flag, and optional description.

sysdba_password.description: Initial SYSDBA password (for first-time setup only). Leave blank to prompt interactively. Not for production.

cache_encryption_key.description: Cache encryption key in memory (only if database encryption is enabled).

plan_logging.description: Log query execution plans (requires QueryLogging = 'plan' or 'all').

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key (PEM format).

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for client/server verification.

role_mapping_file.description: Path to external authentication role mapping file.

max_fetch_buffer_size.description: Rows fetched per server-side cursor batch.

stats_enabled.description: Enable database statistics collection for monitoring.

shadow_auto_create.description: Automatically create shadow files on database creation.

shadow_max_count.description: Maximum number of shadow files per database.

idle_gc_enabled.description: Run garbage collection during idle periods.

idle_gc_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between idle GC runs (0 = disabled).

use_huge_pages.description: Use Linux HugeTLB for large caches (requires system config).

huge_page_size.description: Huge page size in MB (0 = kernel default).

config_reload_file.description: Touch this file to reload firebird.conf without restart. Empty to disable.
